authorization: Operator explicitly requests a new goal and actual research, meaningful physically constrained candidates, cheap-first filter order and compatibility with existing proved TECT content. The original PHY-001 intake was complete; this is a distinct authorized unit, not an automatic successor.
goal: Select at most one prospective phase-transformation microscopic candidate by exact compatibility with existing evidence, or reject the bounded set with a precise failed condition. Do not alter PAH/P1 or assert physical identity.
selection_logic: Use hard eligibility and lexicographic scope review, not an invented weighted score or a scan over arbitrary models. Passing a review filter means a hypothesis is worth testing, not that the universe or TECT realizes it.

filter_order.test: Read the exact current production, ensemble, PAH and failed-candidate boundaries; reject unchanged prohibited substitutions.
filter_order.reject: Rerunning R-157 neutral flow as a nonzero vacuum, repairing PAH by clocks/fitted rates, or using a shell minimum as geometry.

filter_order.test: Tabulate the carrier, functional, state, symmetry, reference, norm, domain and ordered limits required by each intended inherited result.
filter_order.reject: A load-bearing theorem import with mismatched or unspecified assumptions. Method-only reuse must be labeled and supplies no conclusion.

filter_order.test: Locate the actual microscopic variables, action/generator, state and conservation/exchange law in one primary source per candidate family.
filter_order.reject: Only an analogy, a slogan, a static potential called dynamics, or an unfixed physical quantity.

filter_order.test: List supplied versus emergent geometry, clock, dimension and locality. Test whether the candidate addresses phase-origin microphysics rather than only an already-geometric probe.
filter_order.reject: Claiming pregeometry/time emergence while silently inserting the same metric/time. Explicit partial mechanism may survive as partial only, not full Pre-A.

filter_order.test: For the best surviving candidate, freeze one attempted link to a required TECT physical quantity and calculate its actual conservation/balance law and normalization.
filter_order.reject: Equating density, particle number, Noether charge, volume or relational-clock momentum merely by notation. If no link is defined, no numeric fit is allowed.

filter_order.test: Independently check the one source-derived equation, signs/factors, state/domain and approximation boundary; record an explicit falsifier.
filter_order.reject: Finite/source-local success presented as a uniform common-core, physical sector or continuum result.

deliberate_family_slots.rationale: Tests the operator's phase-origin/pregeometric intuition with a condensate, relational observables and actual source dynamics. Group-field-theory condensate cosmology is a targeted source lead, not an adopted TECT model.

Contrasting controlled test of whether changing graph connectivity can supply a nongeometric-to-geometric phase while exposing any assumed external clock. Quantum-graphity is a targeted source lead, not inherited geometry.

source_freeze_rule: This filter order is written before opening external candidate sources or calculating their link. Prior general knowledge identifies only the two named leads. Read source equations before choosing the single deep target; freeze its exact version and input hash before calculation.
reuse_rule: Maximize justified relevance, not the count of old theorems nominally cited. Exact P1/A2 results cannot be imported into a different field theory; a future effective map is an unproved condition. A failed reuse map need not refute the external framework, but it blocks selection for that TECT role.
first_link_template: If reusing R-158, distinguish its Q_P1=||Psi||_2^2/2 from the candidate's actual Noether charge, particle count, volume and clock momentum; derive dQ/dtau or the explicit balance, then test the proposed map. Do not assume an isomorphism or time conversion.
outputs: Versioned source/hash and exact model scope
Current-theorem applicability matrix and first failed filter per candidate
One deeply reviewed candidate contract or precise role-specific rejection
Reproducible exact link check, independent/hostile review, explicit Lean scope
One exploration/checkpoint and one next evidence condition; no intermediate proof PDF
non_claims: No original PAH or P1 changes.
No T-054 gate change from source review alone.
No physical Pre-A, emergent spacetime, QFT, GR, continuum, mass gap or TOE.
No black-hole timelessness or outside-universe equivalence as premise.
No guaranteed successful model or exhaustive nonexistence proof.
